lines.x: So the Doctor's just like Orchid—you have to slay a monster called 'paperwork' every single day, meow?

Yoshitsune, do you remember what the Buddy Plaza looked like, meow? That's right, meow—this part should be drawn like so, meow. There, this chapter's finished. Let's hurry and show Spot, meow! That's right, drawing our hometown's stories is the best way to miss it, meow. Spot's really clever for coming up with the idea, meow!

Popukar and Her Majesty Baowujia have completely different personalities, meow! She kept staring at me before, and I thought I'd done something bad—I was too scared to sleep, meow! I worked up the courage to ask her, and it turned out she just wanted to pet me, meow! Now we're good enough friends to nap together, meow!

Doctor, I'm sorry, meow! Yoshitsune nearly hurt Midnight during training the other day, meow! He mistook Midnight for that indomitable general, so on reflex he just—ah, I don't mean this Midnight isn't tough enough, meow!
Catapult's gone missing again? I'll help Orchid look for her, meow! What—Yoshitsune, you're stopping me?! You're taking Catapult's side, meow?! Fine then, let's settle this, meow!

The Doctor wants to try a Wirebug too, meow? No problem, meow! Grab the silk it secretes from its tail, then fling it in the direction you want to go—uh oh, the Doctor's flung themselves off! Yoshitsune, catch them, quick, meow!

Meow?! You're going to be late for the meeting? Yoshitsune—Doctor, Yoshitsune says to climb on, meow! But be careful, he's very fast, and with your constitution—ah, they're gone, meow. I think I can already hear the Doctor screaming. Nothing for it—let's go bring them some medicine, meow.
Yoshitsune, you're squashing my tail, meow... Meow? Oh, it was the Doctor, meow...

We're Masamune and Yoshitsune, of Kamura Village's Buddy Recon, meow! Leave the intel gathering and material collecting to us, meow! Phew—that went way better than my introduction the first time I met the previous Majesty, meow!
Strong hunters really do all have their own unique way of fighting, meow!
Hunting or scouting, leave it all to us, meow!
That's right—this is a great chance for us to show what we can do, meow!
The hunt begins, meow!
Doctor, Yoshitsune's caught the enemy's scent, meow!
Yoshitsune says the enemy is close by, meow!
Yoshitsune, don't rush in, meow!
Leave it to us, meow!
We'll be sure to bring back intel and materials the Doctor will be happy with, meow!
We'll show you what the Recon can do, meow!
Let's take them out in one go, meow!
That almost hit me, meow!
Feels like we'll get some good materials out of this, meow!
Commanding a mission this hard all the way through—the Doctor's as amazing as those legendary hunters, meow!
I wonder what rare materials we'll get this time—I can't wait, meow!
Doctor, don't let your guard down—there are still enemies nearby, meow!
The cart's ready—hurry, let's haul the Doctor back, meow!
I wonder which is bigger, meow—Rhodes Island's forge, or Kamura Village's?
An ambush, meow? Oh, it's just the Doctor, meow!
All the machinery on Rhodes Island is so complicated, meow...
Arknights.

Yoshitsune, you know what I mean, meow? In the ten years since we left Kamura Village, we've never truly settled it. Hmph, don't think you're the only one who's gotten stronger—I have too, meow. Today's the day, meow. We settle it right here in this snowball fight—Catapult, that was a sneak attack, meow!
Doctor, let's go hunting together, meow!

Doctor, to thank you for looking after us all this time, Yoshitsune and I have prepared a super-deluxe batch of Kamura Village's specialty Bunny Dango! We improved on Yomogi's secret recipe—guaranteed to have you back at work with a hundred times the energy, meow! ...You'll pass after all? Huh, meow?

The 'curse' that spread through the Bubbly Realm seems to exist in Terra too, meow. If we can unravel the secret of the 'curse,' maybe we'll find the road home—and get to visit the Bubbly Realm one more time, meow! If Popukar and the others met a version of themselves that looks 'exactly the same,' they'd definitely get a shock, meow!
